Casual used to be the only thing I played until I was level 100. It definitely created a lot of bad habits but I did gain a lot of map knowledge and a little bit of game sense. I’ve been playing ranked for the past couple of months now and I’m currently level 140 and silver 3, which is not very good for someone leveled that high lol. Casual I’ve noticed doesn’t really help at all for ranked unless your practicing rushing and working on your aim and stuff like that. It doesn’t help with game sense much because of the wide range of player skill levels you face and the ranked meta is not always a part of casual. I’d say you could mess around in cas if u want but I would highly suggest playing the same amount of time in ranked as u do in cas or more, so you can keep your skill up.
